Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Implement QEMU guest agent connection using Jenkins agent commands

- Update QemuGuestAgentLauncher to use Jenkins-generated agent connection commands
- Generate Windows and Unix commands with proper secret file handling
- Implement space-separated command array format for QEMU guest agent
- Add ''--'' separator to prevent guest agent from interpreting hyphenated arguments
- Fix cloud template launcher configuration to use hetero-radio for proper data binding
- Ensure operators (>, &, &&) have proper spacing for array element splitting

The launcher now generates commands that match Jenkins UI recommendations:
- Windows: echo <secret> > secret-file & curl.exe -sO <url>/agent.jar & java -jar agent.jar -url <url> -secret @secret-file -name <name> -webSocket -workDir <dir>
- Unix: printf ''%s'' <secret> > secret-file && curl -sO <url>/agent.jar && java -jar agent.jar -url <url> -secret @secret-file -name <name> -webSocket -workDir <dir>

Commands are split into space-separated array elements and sent to QEMU guest agent
with proper ''--'' separator for security and compatibility.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
